items.source:
Returns all entities matching the given Example applying the given Sort. In case no match could be found an empty List is returned.
By default the Example uses typed matching restricting it to probe assignable types. For example, when sticking with the default type key (_class), the query has restrictions such as _class : { $in : [com.acme.Person] }.
To avoid the above mentioned type restriction use an UntypedExampleMatcher with Example.of(Object, org.springframework.data.domain.ExampleMatcher).
items.translation:
返回所有匹配给定 Example 并应用给定 Sort 的实体。如果未找到匹配项，则返回一个空的 List。
默认情况下，Example 使用类型匹配，将其限制为可探测的赋值类型。例如，当坚持使用默认类型键（_class）时，查询具有如下限制：_class : { $in : [com.acme.Person] }。
为避免上述提到的类型限制，请使用 UntypedExampleMatcher 配合 Example.of(Object, org.springframework.data.domain.ExampleMatcher)。

items.source: Inserts the given entities. Assumes the given entities to have not been persisted yet and thus will optimize the insert over a call to ListCrudRepository.saveAll(Iterable). Prefer using ListCrudRepository.saveAll(Iterable) to avoid the usage of store specific API.
items.translation: 插入给定的实体。假定这些实体尚未持久化，因此将优化对ListCrudRepository.saveAll(Iterable)的调用。为避免使用特定于存储层的 API，建议使用ListCrudRepository.saveAll(Iterable)。

items.source: Inserts the given entity. Assumes the instance to be new to be able to apply insertion optimizations. Use the returned instance for further operations as the save operation might have changed the entity instance completely. Prefer using CrudRepository.save(Object) instead to avoid the usage of store-specific API.
items.translation: 插入给定的实体。假设该实例是新的，以便应用插入优化。请使用返回的实例进行后续操作，因为保存操作可能会完全更改实体实例。建议改用CrudRepository.save(Object)，以避免使用特定于存储的 API。
